headline: Revenue and margins improve, EPS drop skewed by prior year
summary_short: IFF posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1.954B (+1.8% y/y) with gross profit up 3.5% y/y to $853M and operating income up 11.3% y/y to $158M, while diluted EPS fell 91.4% y/y to $0.20 and net income dropped to $50M from $599M a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue rose 1.8% y/y to $1.954B on the same SEC-verbatim basis as the prior-year quarter. Gross profit grew faster than sales, up 3.5% y/y to $853M, and operating income rose 11.3% y/y to $158M. Below the operating line, net income fell 91.7% y/y to $50M and diluted EPS fell 91.4% y/y to $0.20 from $2.33 — a decline concentrated well below the operating-income line. Total cash fell 30.3% y/y to $569M; long-term debt fell 16.7% y/y to $4.735B; shareholders' equity was roughly flat, down 3.0% y/y.
